Covariate balance from the implicit weights of a TWFE regression

Source: R/twfeweights_mp.R
twfe_cov_bal.Rd

Computes how well the implicit weights from implicit_twfe_weights() balance covariates between each treated group and the never-treated group, for each \((g,t)\) cell.

Usage

twfe_cov_bal(decomposed_twfe, extra_balance_vars_formula)

Arguments

decomposed_twfe

A decomposed_twfe object from implicit_twfe_weights().

extra_balance_vars_formula

One-sided formula for the covariates to report balance for, e.g. ~ x1 + x2 + region. They do not need to be in the TWFE regression.

Value

The decomposed_twfe object with a balance table cov_bal_df added to each element of twfe_gt.

Details

Each covariate is first averaged over time within each unit, and balance is assessed for these time averages (as in Caetano and Callaway, 2026). Use summary.decomposed_twfe() for a table averaged over post-treatment cells and ggtwfeweights() to plot it.

Examples

data(castle, package = "causaldata")
castle <- as.data.frame(castle)
castle$G <- BMisc::get_group(castle, "sid", tname = "year", treatname = "post")
tw <- implicit_twfe_weights(
  yname = "l_homicide", tname = "year", idname = "sid", gname = "G",
  xformula = ~l_police, base_period = "gmin1", data = castle
)
